headers.subject: Offer: Analytics Engineer at Arbor Analytics

snippet: Hi Mateo, I am delighted to share that we would like to offer you the Analytics Engineer position. The offer letter is linked below.
bodyText:
Hi Mateo,

I am delighted to share that we would like to offer you the Analytics Engineer position at Arbor Analytics. The full offer letter, with compensation and start date, is here: https://offers.arboranalytics.example/letter/ae-2026-0412

Please let me know by Friday 9 October if you have questions.

Best regards,
Lena Fischer
Senior recruiter, Arbor Analytics

extraction.summary: Arbor Analytics offered you the Analytics Engineer position.
